## Highlights since 0.12.1

- **The agent looks at a figure before inserting it.** When the agent draws a TikZ or PGFPlots figure, it now typesets it with your paper's preamble at column width and checks the picture, so labels over curves, legends over data and plots wider than the column are fixed before the figure reaches your paper. Your build, PDF and SyncTeX are left alone, and the insertion can be reviewed and undone like any agent edit.
- **Smoother LaTeX input.** Enter on an `\item` line starts the next item, and on an empty item leaves the list. Typing `\left(` or `\bigl[` writes the matching `\right)` or `\bigr]`. Hovering a `\ref` or `\eqref` shows the equation with its number and page. `%novalidate` lines and regions get no LaTeX diagnostics, and ⌥⌘M opens a searchable math symbol palette.
- **Submission checks for double-blind venues.** The submission checklist flags what reviewers would catch: a template option that prints the authors, acknowledgements or `\thanks` left in, links to your own code accounts, author names in the PDF's metadata, and Type 3 or unembedded fonts.
- **Grammar checks tuned for papers.** LaTeX is checked with an academic profile that accepts common paper usage and abbreviations. Choose American or British English and switch single rules in Settings, and ignore a sentence or a rule for the whole project from a suggestion.

## Notable fixes

- A double-click in the PDF lands on the word you clicked, not just its line.
- Your last edits are saved before a window closes, Lattice quits, or the page reloads, and an error in one panel stays in that panel instead of taking down the window.
- The outline reads headings the way TeX does, skipping comments, verbatim and macro bodies.
- Label and citation checks keep working when a project has unreadable files, and citations update when a .bib changes outside the editor.
- A compile error opens the exact file it names, and a path whose letter case differs from the file on disk is reported as such, including before arXiv export.
- Files with Windows (CRLF) line breaks keep them when saved.
- Edit › Select All selects the whole document.
- Typing `"` or `'` in LaTeX inserts one character instead of an auto-closed pair.
- Words with TeX accents, such as `na\"ive`, are no longer flagged as misspellings.
- Overleaf: files whose paths differ only in letter case are set aside instead of one being silently dropped.
- The PDF redraws sharply after the window moves to a display with a different pixel density.
- Background git reads no longer run programs named in a project's .git/config.
